Hey Alex —

Great to meet you today — thanks for the clear constraints. Quick answers up-front and then a proposed playbook for the tech call:

- Egress: We support both NAT egress (fixed outbound IPs) and VPC interface endpoints depending on your networking preference. For HIPAA workloads where outbound auditing and IP allowlists are required, customers commonly route through their NAT with strict egress logging.
- DNS: Private/internal DNS is supported when deploying Redwood Private into a VPC; we can configure split-horizon DNS so internal hostnames resolve only inside your network.
- mTLS/certs: Redwood Private supports mutual TLS for our control plane connections and can be configured to use customer-provided client certs. We also support automated cert rotation via an integration with your internal CA or by using our KMS-backed cert manager.

Proposed next steps (tech alignment):
1) 60-min call to walk network routing options, auth model (API key vs. mTLS), and SDK onboarding (structured output + tool calling).
2) Pre-call ask: please share the IP ranges you need whitelisted, and whether you prefer NAT egress or VPC endpoints.
3) We'll send a short mutual action plan after the call with owners and dates.

I copied Karthik (solutions eng) and Marissa (account lead) so Karthik can run the deep-dive and Marissa can start procurement cadence. Does Mon 2027-08-23 10:00 PT or Tue 2027-08-24 09:00 PT work for you?

—Rachel

Alex / Rachel —

Thanks — I can take the deep-dive. A few technical clarifications to make the call effective:

1) NAT vs. VPC endpoint tradeoffs:
   - NAT (egress from customer subnet): simplest for IP allowlist requirements; you control the public IPs. Works well if you want all traffic logged by your outbound proxy.
   - VPC interface endpoints (AWS PrivateLink style): avoids public egress, lower surface area, but requires us to publish a service endpoint in your account or region. If you want per-route isolation (e.g., embeddings traffic to dedicated infra) we can set up multiple endpoints.

2) Auth models we should cover: API keys scoped to route/model (fastest), mTLS (stronger identity binding), and token-based ephemeral creds (for short-lived tool-calling contexts). If you plan to do client cert rotation via your CA, please bring your rotation cadence and CA type to the call.

3) SDK/structured-output & tool calling:
   - We'll demo our SDK sample config (I attached redwood-sdk-example.yaml) that shows auth fields, routing (route_name -> model_id), and structured-output hooks for tool invocation.
   - Embeddings/rerank: recommend starting with single-index embeddings and a simple reranker pipeline (embedding similarity -> LightRerank model). We'll discuss throughput expectations so we can size dedicated capacity if needed.

Pre-call ask (please reply on this thread):
- Preferred egress model (NAT or PrivateLink)
- IP ranges to allowlist if NAT
- Point of contact for cert rotation/procurement (we'll need a procurement email)

I'll send a calendar invite for Mon 2027-08-23 10:00 PT.

—Karthik
